items.name: Wild Curse
items.text: The Dig Beast is loaded with cursed energy but also is hard to control. At the start of its turn, roll 1d6. On a 1–2 it is Slowed 1 until end of its turn, on a 3–4 it is neither slowed nor Quickened (unless from another effect), and on a 5–6 it is quickened until the end of its turn.

items.name: Crashing Ram
items.text: The Dig Beast rushes at a target and crashes into it. The Dig Beast strides twice and performs a shovel teeth attack against each adjacent target. These attacks count against its multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after all the attacks.
